summary: Kerb backing onto bush, where cars already park; homes only across the road.
reasons: Bush on the kerb side, no dwellings

drivers.seclusion: Bushland backs the whole west side; nearest homes are 19 m or more away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Dirt shoulder beside the lane and cars parked at the kerb show room to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Two-lane suburban road with moderate traffic; van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked on this kerb in both Esri and QLD, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Homes 19-29 m away across the road
Gate on a side track 216 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Bush to the west gives afternoon shade; morning sun reaches the kerb from the east.

best_section.where: West kerb of Taringa Parade just north of the side-street junction, beside the bushland
